<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --M:#c51f4e;--M2:#a01840;
  --cream:#f5f0e8;--cream2:#ede7d9;
  --char:#1a1a1a;--muted:#6b6358;
  --gold:#c9960e;--white:#ffffff;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--char);overflow-x:hidden}

nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 56px;background:rgba(245,240,232,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(197,31,78,0.14)}

.hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding-top:76px;overflow:hidden}

.hero-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--M);margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.hero-eyebrow::before{content:'';display:block;width:28px;height:1px;background:var(--M)}
.hero-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(44px,5.5vw,76px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.08;color:var(--char);margin-bottom:24px}
.hero-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--M)}
.hero-sub{font-size:15px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted);max-width:380px;margin-bottom:44px}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-p{background:var(--M);color:#fff;border:none;padding:15px 38px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;transition:background .2s,transform .15s}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--M2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-s{background:transparent;color:var(--char);border:1px solid var(--char);padding:14px 34px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;transition:all .2s}
.btn-s:hover{background:var(--char);color:var(--cream)}
.hero-right{position:relative;background:var(--cream2);overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.hero-right::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(197,31,78,.04) 0,rgba(197,31,78,.04) 1px,transparent 1px,transparent 22px)}
.hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;padding:44px;transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}
.hero-grid img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.13);transition:transform .4s ease}
.hero-grid img:nth-child(odd){transform:translateY(14px)}
.hero-grid img:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(-14px)}
.hero-grid img:hover{transform:scale(1.05) !important}

.marquee{background:var(--M);color:#fff;padding:13px 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.marquee-inner{display:inline-block;animation:ticker 20s linear infinite}
.marquee-inner span{font-size:11px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 44px}
.marquee-inner span::after{content:'✦';padding-left:44px;opacity:.5}
@keyframes ticker{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

.section{padding:96px 80px}
.sec-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--M);margin-bottom:10px}
.sec-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,50px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;color:var(--char)}

.view-all{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--M);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--M);padding-bottom:2px;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:6px;transition:opacity .2s}
.view-all:hover{opacity:.65}

.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
.pcard{cursor:pointer}
.pimg{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cream2);margin-bottom:14px;aspect-ratio:3/4}
.pimg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease}
.pcard:hover .pimg img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.pbadge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:var(--M);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 9px}
.pbadge.new{background:var(--char)}
.qadd{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--char);color:#fff;border:none;padding:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .3s ease}
.pcard:hover .qadd{transform:translateY(0)}
.pname{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;color:var(--char);margin-bottom:4px}
.pvar{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:6px}
.pprice{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--M)}
.pswatches{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.sw{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s}
.sw:hover,.sw.on{border-color:var(--char)}

.fbanner{margin:0 80px 96px;background:var(--char);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;overflow:hidden;min-height:500px}
.fbc{padding:72px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}

.values{padding:96px 80px;background:var(--cream2)}

.vitem{border-top:2px solid var(--M);padding-top:24px}

.vdesc{font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted)}

.nls{margin:0 80px 96px;background:var(--M);padding:72px 80px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.nls::before{content:'MAISIE*';position:absolute;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:140px;font-weight:700;font-style:italic;color:rgba(255,255,255,.06);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}
.nl-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);margin-bottom:16px}
.nl-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(24px,3.5vw,44px);font-weight:500;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.nl-sub{font-size:14px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);margin-bottom:36px}

.nl-input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.nl-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--M);border:none;padding:15px 28px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer}

footer{background:var(--char);color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);padding:68px 80px 36px}

.ft-col-t{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px}
.ft-links{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.ft-links a{text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);transition:color .2s}

.ft-bot{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-top:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ft-copy,.ft-domain{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);letter-spacing:.04em}
</style>

  <div class="vgrid">
    <div class="vitem"><p class="vnum">01</p><h3 class="vtitle">Padded Protection</h3><p class="vdesc">Triple-quilted padding absorbs impact so your laptop stays safe. Every stitch is both structure and style.</p></div>
    <div class="vitem"><p class="vnum">02</p><h3 class="vtitle">Bold by Design</h3><p class="vdesc">Each print is an original MAISIE* pattern — designed in Tbilisi, limited in quantity, impossible to ignore.</p></div>
    <div class="vitem"><p class="vnum">03</p><h3 class="vtitle">Made to Last</h3><p class="vdesc">High-density fabric, reinforced seams, and a magnetic closure that holds through every commute, flight, and café session.</p></div>
